concepts.name: Consulting Type Configurations
concepts.summary: Spring Boot 4 (Java 21) service managing consulting type configurations: the per-consulting-type settings stored in MongoDB that drive registration, session behavior, and feature toggles across the platform. Public read endpoints (basic/extended/full, by slug, by tenant) plus an admin API for create/update.

concepts.name: Topics & Topic Groups
concepts.summary: TopicController, TopicAdminController, and TopicGroupsController with TopicServiceFacade manage counseling topics and their grouping — the taxonomy agencies and consultants are matched against. Topics are multilingual (i18n-aware name/description), carry fallback agency/URL and welcome-message settings, and live in MariaDB via Liquibase-managed schema. The published OpenAPI contract was corrected in July 2026 (issue #96): welcomeMessage/fallbackUrl are plain strings, ids are integer/int64.

concepts.name: Application Settings & Global SMTP
concepts.summary: ApplicationSettingsController and ApplicationSettingsServiceFacade expose platform-wide application settings (Mongo-backed) consumed by other services and the frontends. Since mid-2026 they also carry the global SMTP configuration: passwords are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM (SmtpPasswordEncryptionService) only when settings.smtp.password.encryption.secret is configured — without that secret the service silently falls back to storing them plaintext at rest and credentials are no longer leaked through the public /settings endpoint.

concepts.name: DPA (AVV) Signing Email Dispatch
concepts.summary: New since July 2026 (TEN-INV-U5): POST /settingsadmin/dpa-signing-emails sends the one-time DPA/AVV signing link to a tenant contact using the global SMTP settings. DpaSigningEmailService pins the sign link to the configured app origin and the /dpa-sign/ path, builds a German HTML mail, and returns a strict success-or-error receipt; JakartaDpaMailTransport enforces STARTTLS (mail.smtp.starttls.required) and server-identity verification, classifying unparseable recipients as 400 and SMTP failures as 502 (SmtpSendException). Known drift: this endpoint is deliberately absent from every OpenAPI spec, so contract gates do not cover it.

concepts.name: Tenant Resolution & Isolation
concepts.summary: Multitenancy support: HttpTenantFilter and TenantResolver establish the tenant per request, TenantContext holds it thread-locally, and TenantAspect plus tenant-aware repositories scope data access. Hardened July 2026 (#43): when a subdomain is present it is authoritative — a tenantId header that contradicts the subdomain-derived tenant is rejected with AccessDenied instead of being trusted; the header fallback remains only for genuine internal service-to-service calls.

concepts.name: OpenAPI Provider/Consumer Contract Gate
concepts.summary: New since July 2026 (#96/#51): CI publishes the provider OpenAPI bundles and runs an oasdiff breaking-change gate against the previous contracts, with a reviewed one-time allowlist for accepted corrections (contracts/topic-format-correction-96.md). Python meta-tests under tests/ci and tests/contracts assert that the gate and the required integration-test suite actually execute in CI rather than silently passing.

concepts.name: Observability: OTLP to SigNoz
concepts.summary: OBS-P2/OBS-P5 (July 2026): traces and metrics ship via OTLP to the SigNoz gateway collector (sampling pinned to 100% on Pre-Dev), logs are JSON-structured via logback-spring.xml, and CorrelationIdFilter propagates X-Correlation-ID into the SLF4J MDC (key CID) with the same naming as UserService so requests correlate across services. The Sentry SDK was removed once SigNoz reached parity.

concepts.name: Liquibase Schema Management (re-enabled)
concepts.summary: Liquibase was re-enabled in July 2026 with a single master changelog (consultingtypeservice-master.xml) for all environments, replacing the per-environment masters; contexts select environment-specific changesets and are overridable via SPRING_LIQUIBASE_CONTEXTS (Pre-Dev override, #112). Spring Boot 4 dropped Liquibase from the default classpath, so spring-boot-starter-liquibase is an explicit dependency and guard tests fail the build if the auto-configuration silently disappears again.

concepts.name: Spring Boot 4 / Java 21 Migration Fixes
concepts.summary: The service runs on Spring Boot 4.0.1 with Java 21. SB4-specific fixes landed June/July 2026: the Mongo URI property was renamed to spring.mongodb.uri (the old spring.data.mongodb.uri key is no longer bound — the earlier live breakage is fixed at this commit), TrailingSlashFilter restores the trailing-slash request matching SB4 removed, and Liquibase needs its explicit starter (see the migrations concept).

flows.name: Topic Administration
flows.summary: Admin creates or updates topics/topic groups (TopicAdminController) → TopicValidationService and TopicServiceFacade validate and persist → topics become available for agency/consultant matching and registration.

flows.name: DPA Signing Email Dispatch
flows.summary: Caller with AUTHORIZATION_PATCH_APPLICATION_SETTINGS (UserService DPA/AVV flow) POSTs recipient, tenant name, sign link, and expiry → DpaSigningEmailService validates the link against the configured app origin and /dpa-sign/ path → loads global SMTP settings and decrypts the password → JakartaDpaMailTransport sends with mandatory STARTTLS and server-identity check → 200 with a SENT receipt only after the SMTP server accepted the message; 502 on transport failure, 400 on invalid recipient.

flows.name: Tenant Request Resolution
flows.summary: Incoming request → HttpTenantFilter triggers resolution → TenantResolver derives the tenant from the request subdomain (authoritative) and rejects a contradicting tenantId header; without a subdomain the header is used for internal calls → TenantContext carries the tenant for the request → tenant-aware repositories and the Hibernate interceptor scope all reads/writes.

layerDescriptions.Core: Spring Boot application core: entry point, configuration, security/tenant infrastructure, and repository-level scripts.
